lines: Hawkins concluded, “Looking forward we expect the second half trends to be consistent with what we saw in the first half, recognizing that SG&A in the second half of fiscal 2026 benefited from a non-recurring $6.2 million reduction in SG&A which will not recur in the second half of fiscal 2027.”
Our effective tax rate for the full year is expected to be approximately 25% to 27%.
